[P1] 学前儿童
生理
启蒙必备
互动、好玩的幼儿人体百科
翻翻页、推拉页、转盘机关、变色、触摸……
我们的
身体
[法]帕斯卡尔·艾德兰 文
[法]罗伯特·巴尔博里尼 图
荣信文化 编译
陕西新华出版传媒集团
未来出版社
乐乐趣

[P2] 生命的开始
宝宝的生命是从妈妈肚子里开始的。你也不例外哦！

伟大的爱！
爸爸和妈妈
相爱了，宝宝是
他们爱的结晶。
爸爸的精子细胞
和妈妈的卵子细胞
相结合，形成
受精卵。受精卵
不断分裂，最终
形成完整的人体
结构。

[P3] 在羊水袋中
快看，宝宝浮在妈妈肚子里一个充满液体的
水袋中，这个叫羊水袋，能很好地保护宝宝。宝
宝还会在羊水袋里做运动，挥舞手脚！

[P4] 宝宝的出生
9个月后，预产期到了。天气多么晴朗，阳光多么明媚，真是
个好日子，宝宝也做好准备了。他马上就要钻出妈妈的肚子了！

快去医院
频繁阵痛，妈妈知道宝宝
马上就要出生了。快，快送到
医院去。医生和护士也都赶来
帮助生产。

生产
宝宝出生时，头部先离开羊水袋。
呀，宝宝的头已经出来了！妈妈也会让
腹部的肌肉用力，使宝宝顺利出生。

拉拉着，帮宝宝出生……

哇！哇！哇！
宝宝顺利出生了！
第一次靠自己的鼻子呼吸，宝宝觉得很难受，
因此大声地啼哭。

[P5] 整个儿童时代，你不断成长，也逐渐进步。

8岁
15岁

3岁

6个月
5岁
10岁

拉拉看，你能明显地看到每个年龄段的身体差异。

[P6] 肌肉
你的身上遍布肌肉，它们被皮肤覆盖着，无法用肉眼直接
看到。肌肉为人体运动系统提供动力。

力量
你看到图中那位大力士身上的肌肉块了吗？正是这些肌肉让他变得非常强壮。

运动
跑步、闭眼、笑、活动手指……人体的每一个
动作都要靠肌肉的运动来完成。这些肌肉的运动都是由大脑中枢神经控制完成的。

哎哟！好痛！
运动过猛会拉伤或撕裂肌肉，这
会让人疼痛难耐！为了治愈受伤的肌肉，受伤者需要好好静养，不能再去
碰受伤的部位。

[P7] 骨骼
骨骼是维持身体活动的重要部件。身体正因为有骨骼支撑，
人才能直立行走。

保护
骨骼虽然轻，但却很坚固。许多骨骼保护着身体内比较脆弱的器官，比如：颅骨保护大脑，可以抵御外来的冲击和伤害。

大和小
骨头有大有小，形状也各不相同：肱骨、尺骨较长，肩胛骨扁平，指骨和趾骨较小……

肩胛骨
肱骨
桡（ráo）骨
尺骨

骨折
意外的强烈撞击会导致骨折。别担心，骨折是可以治愈的。为了使骨骼痊愈，医生通常会在损伤的部位打上石膏，加以固定。

[P8] 手指：五个小兄弟
翻起“手掌”，里面就是手掌骨骼的示意图。构成手指的小型长骨叫指骨。儿童的指骨比成年人的脆弱，因为它们并未完全发育，还在继续生长。当指骨定型后，坚韧度会提高很多。

1、2、3，握拳！
人体的每块骨头都不是独立存在的，它们之间由软骨关节或纤维关节相互连接。关节使人体能够灵活地运动和弯曲。因此，你才能握紧拳头。

[P9] 手指：五个小兄弟
翻起“手掌”，里面就是手掌骨骼的示意图。构成手指的小型长骨叫指骨。儿童的指骨比成年人的脆弱，因为它们并未完全发育，还在继续生长。当指骨定型后，坚韧度会提高很多。

[P10] 血液循环
血液从心脏流出时是鲜红色的，含有大量氧气。血液在循环过程中，收集身体转化的能量，分配到各个器官，最终再流回心脏。这时的血液因含有较多身体代谢废物而变成暗红色。

[P11] 移动小球，看看蔬菜在消化系统中有哪些变化。

嘴巴
蔬菜进入口腔时，牙齿会将蔬菜嚼碎。舌头搅拌蔬菜，并分泌唾液使其软化。随后蔬菜被咽下。

食道
咀嚼成小块的蔬菜被吞入食道中。数一数：1、2、3、4、5……全部滑向了食道底端。

胃
胃是一个由肌肉构成的袋状器官，它能分泌胃液、消化食物，使食物变成滑腻的乳脂状食糜。

肠道
食糜来到肠道，被进一步分解成小分子。营养部分被身体吸收，不能被吸收的那部分又该怎么处理呢？拉拉着……

[P12] 竖牙利齿
当你还是婴儿时，你只喝母乳或奶粉，不需要牙齿。没多久，乳牙长了出来，
你可以咀嚼食物和咬手指了！6岁时，你开始换牙。乳牙一颗一颗地脱落，长出新
的恒牙。等你长大了，你的牙齿就和图中的一样齐全了。

张开嘴照照镜子，
看看你的牙齿和图中的
有哪些不一样。

舌头
6颗臼齿 (D)
4颗磨碎食物
的前臼齿 (C)
2颗将食物撕成
小块的大齿 (B)
4颗将食物切
开的门牙 (A)
小舌

[P13] 皮肤
皮肤非常有弹性，也很坚韧，它将身体的器官都包裹起来。
皮肤不愧是身体的铠甲——尽管它很薄！

超级防护
皮肤能够防止体内的水分流失。如果没有皮肤，
身体就无法保存水分，变得很干燥。皮肤能生成一层
防水的脂肪层，既能抵御寒冷、缓解外界的冲击，又
能阻挡病毒的入侵。

毛
毛孔
皮层

神经
血管

毛发
人的全身皮肤几乎都长有毛发，不过有些毛发非常细短，可能会被忽视，但头发我们都能清楚地看到。毛发可以遮挡尘埃和微生物进入我们的身体。除此之外，毛发还有哪些作用呢？你不妨说说看。

揭开身体的奥秘
皮肤下面是什么？想看看皮肤下隐藏的秘密，那就打开翻页吧！一边游戏一边对自己的身体做一个全新的认识，并了解身体内部的构造。

[P14] 水痘
左蕾的身体一直很好，不过最近她被病毒感染了。
拉开两板，看看左蕾的身上出现了什么……

左蕾患上水痘了！水痘这种病会使患者发烧，并且全身起红色
小疙瘩。如果患了水痘，应注意别将脓包抓破，否则会在身上留下
难看的疤痕。并且尽量在家里好好休养一段时间，不要外出，以免
将水痘传染给他人。

[P15] 头
眼睛
手臂
性器官
脚

[P16] 男孩
额头
耳朵
肚脐
性器官
小腿

[P1] Preschool Children
Physiology
Essential for启蒙
Interactive, Fun Children's Human Body Encyclopedia
Flap pages, pull-out pages, spinning mechanisms, color-changing, touch-and-feel...
Our
Body
[France] Pascal Edlan, Text
[France] Robert Balbourni, Illustrations
Rongxin Culture, Compiler and Translator
Shaanxi Xinhua Publishing Media Group
Future Publishing House
Lelvle

[P2] The Beginning of Life
A baby's life begins in mom's tummy. You're no exception!

Great Love!
Dad and mom
fell in love, and the baby
is the fruit of their love.
The dad's sperm cell
and the mom's egg cell
combine to form
a fertilized egg. The fertilized egg
keeps dividing, and eventually
forms a complete human body
structure.

[P3] In the Amniotic Sac
Look, the baby floats inside a liquid-filled sac in Mommy's tummy. This is called the amniotic sac, and it protects the baby very well. The baby also moves around inside the amniotic sac, waving its arms and legs!

[P4] Baby's Birth
After 9 months, the due date has arrived. The weather is so sunny, the sunlight so bright—it's a wonderful day! The baby is also ready. He's about to come out of his mother's tummy!

Go to the Hospital
With frequent contractions, Mom knows the baby is about to be born. Hurry, hurry to the hospital! The doctor and nurse are also rushing to help with the delivery.

Delivery
When the baby is born, his head first leaves the amniotic sac.
Oh, the baby's head is out! Mom will also use her abdominal muscles to help the baby be born smoothly.

Pulling, helping the baby be born...

Wah! Wah! Wah!
The baby is born successfully!
For the first time, breathing through his own nose, the baby feels very uncomfortable, so he cries loudly.

[P5] Throughout childhood, you keep growing and making progress.

8 years old
15 years old

3 years old

6 months
5 years old
10 years old

Pull and see—you can clearly observe the physical differences at each age.

[P6] Muscles
Your body is covered with muscles, which are hidden under the skin and cannot be seen directly. Muscles provide power for the human movement system.

Strength
Do you see the muscle mass on the strongman in the picture? It's these muscles that make him very strong.

Movement
Running, closing eyes, smiling, moving fingers... every action of the human body is completed by muscle movement. These muscle movements are controlled by the central nervous system in the brain.

Ouch! It hurts!
Excessive exercise can strain or tear muscles, which can cause severe pain! To heal injured muscles, the injured person needs to rest well and should not touch the injured area again.

[P7] Skeleton
The skeleton is an important part for maintaining body movement. It is precisely because of the skeletal support that humans can walk upright.

Protection
Although the skeleton is light, it is very sturdy. Many bones protect the body's more fragile organs. For example, the skull protects the brain and can resist external impacts and injuries.

Big and Small
Bones vary in size and shape: the humerus and ulna are long, the scapula is flat, and the phalanges and metatarsals are small...

Scapula
Humerus
Radius (ráo) bone
Ulna

Fracture
Sudden, strong impacts can cause fractures. Don't worry—fractures can be cured. To help the bone heal, doctors usually apply a cast to the injured area to immobilize it.

[P8] Fingers: Five Little Brothers
Lift up the 'palm' to see a diagram of the hand bones. The small long bones that make up the fingers are called phalanges. Children's phalanges are more fragile than adults' because they are not yet fully developed and are still growing. Once the phalanges are fully formed, their toughness will increase significantly.

1, 2, 3, Make a Fist!
The bones in the human body are not independent; they are connected by cartilaginous joints or fibrous joints. Joints allow the body to move and bend flexibly. That's why you can make a tight fist.

[P9] Fingers: Five Little Brothers
Lift up the 'palm' to reveal a diagram of the hand bones. The small long bones that make up the fingers are called phalanges. Children's phalanges are more fragile than adults' because they are not yet fully developed and are still growing. Once the phalanges are fully formed, their toughness will increase significantly.

[P10] Blood Circulation
Blood is bright red when it flows out of the heart, containing a large amount of oxygen. During circulation, blood collects energy converted by the body, distributes it to various organs, and finally returns to the heart. At this point, the blood turns dark red due to the presence of more metabolic waste from the body.

[P11] Move the small ball and see how vegetables change in the digestive system.

Mouth
When vegetables enter the mouth, teeth chew them. The tongue mixes the vegetables and secretes saliva to soften them. Then the vegetables are swallowed.

Esophagus
Chewed pieces of vegetables are swallowed into the esophagus. Count: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5... all sliding down to the bottom of the esophagus.

Stomach
The stomach is a bag-like organ made of muscle. It secretes gastric juice to digest food, turning it into a smooth, creamy mass called chyme.

Intestines
The chyme reaches the intestines, where it is further broken down into small molecules. The nutritious parts are absorbed by the body. What happens to the parts that cannot be absorbed? Pooping...

[P12] Sharp Teeth
When you were a baby, you only drank breast milk or formula and didn't need teeth. Soon after, your baby teeth grew in, and you could chew food and bite your fingers! At age 6, you start losing your baby teeth. One by one, they fall out and are replaced by new permanent teeth. When you grow up, your teeth will be as complete as shown in the picture.

Open your mouth and look in the mirror.
See how your teeth are different from the ones in the picture.

Tongue
6 molars (D)
4 premolars that grind food (C)
2 canines that tear food into small pieces (B)
4 incisors that cut food (A)
Little tongue

[P13] Skin
Skin is very elastic and tough, wrapping up all the organs in the body.
Skin is truly the body's armor—even though it's very thin!

Super Protection
Skin prevents water loss from the body. Without skin,
the body cannot retain moisture and becomes very dry. Skin can produce a
waterproof fatty layer that can resist cold, cushion external impacts, and
also block viruses from invading.

Hair
Pores
Epidermis

Nerves
Blood vessels

Hair
Almost all of the human skin has hair, but some hairs are very fine and short, and may be overlooked. However, we can clearly see our hair. Hair can block dust and microorganisms from entering our bodies. Besides this, what other functions does hair have? You might want to think about it.

Unveiling the Secrets of the Body
What's beneath the skin? Want to see the secrets hidden under the skin? Then open the flap! Play and learn a brand-new understanding of your own body, and discover its internal structure.

[P14] Chickenpox
Zuo Lei has always been healthy, but recently she was infected by a virus.
Open the two flaps and see what has appeared on Zuo Lei's body...

Zuo Lei has chickenpox! This illness causes fever and red bumps all over the body. If you have chickenpox, be careful not to scratch the blisters, or you may leave unsightly scars. Also, try to rest at home for a while, avoid going out, to prevent spreading chickenpox to others.

Eyes

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《我们的身体》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息及人体结构插图，包括骨骼、消化系统、循环系统等，强调互动性和科普性。
[P2] 本页介绍了生命的开始，说明宝宝的生命始于妈妈的肚子里，并通过文字和插图解释了精子与卵子结合形成受精卵，最终发育成完整人体的过程。
[P3] 本页展示了胎儿在羊水袋中的情景，文字说明羊水袋能保护宝宝，并描述宝宝在其中活动、挥舞手脚。
[P4] 本页描绘了宝宝出生的过程，包括妈妈临产时被送往医院、生产时的场景以及宝宝顺利出生后大声啼哭的情景，文字和插图共同展现了分娩的关键时刻。
[P5] 本页通过可拉出的插图展示了儿童从6个月到15岁不同年龄段的身体成长变化，并配有文字说明，引导读者观察各阶段的身体差异。
[P6] 本页介绍了人体肌肉的功能，包括为运动系统提供动力、产生力量以及控制各种动作，并提醒运动过猛可能导致肌肉拉伤或撕裂，需要静养恢复。
[P7] 本页介绍了人体骨骼的功能，包括支撑身体、保护内脏器官、骨骼的大小形状差异，以及骨折的成因和治疗方法。
[P8] 本页通过手掌插图介绍了手指骨骼（指骨）的特点，说明儿童指骨因未完全发育而较脆弱，以及骨骼通过关节连接，使人体能灵活运动和握拳。
[P9] 本页通过手掌骨骼示意图，介绍了手指骨骼（指骨）的结构，并说明儿童指骨因未完全发育而较脆弱，随着生长定型后会变得更坚韧。
[P10] 本页通过人体示意图介绍血液循环系统，说明血液从心脏流出时为鲜红色，携带氧气，流经身体各处后因携带代谢废物而变为暗红色，最终返回心脏。
[P11] 本页通过人体消化系统示意图，介绍了蔬菜从嘴巴进入后，在食道、胃和肠道中的消化过程，并配有互动提示，引导读者观察食物在体内的变化。
[P12] 本页通过口腔示意图介绍恒牙的结构和功能，说明乳牙在6岁左右开始脱落并被恒牙替换，并标注了门牙、犬齿、前臼齿和臼齿的名称与作用，同时引导读者观察自身牙齿与图示的差异。
[P13] 本页介绍了皮肤的结构和功能，包括其弹性、坚韧性和作为身体铠甲的保护作用，通过插图展示了皮肤的层次结构（毛、毛孔、皮层、神经、血管），并说明了毛发的防护作用，最后引导读者通过翻页探索皮肤下的身体奥秘。
[P14] 本页介绍了水痘的症状和注意事项，通过插图展示女孩左蕾全身出现红色小疙瘩，并说明水痘会引发发烧，需避免抓破脓包以防留疤，并建议居家休养以防传染。
[P15] 本页展示了一个儿童全身示意图，并用标签标注了头、眼睛、手臂、性器官和脚等身体部位。
[P16] 本页展示了一个男孩的全身示意图，并用标签标注了额头、耳朵、肚脐、性器官和小腿等身体部位。
[P17] 本页以人体示意图为中心，标注了口腔、食管、胃、肠、肝脏、心脏和大脑等主要器官，并设有‘首页介绍’和‘精彩推荐’板块，分别介绍人体百科启蒙内容和生命起源知识，同时包含关于水痘的互动提问。
